title: The Cech differential preserves permutation equivariance
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I any type, U : I → Opens(X) a family of opens [def-sc-zariski-site], F : Opens(X)^op → Ab a presheaf of abelian groups, and S the chosen finite-intersection Čech complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let p ≥ 0 and let c be a degree-p full Čech cochain. Assume for every tuple t : Fin(p+1) → I and permutation σ of Fin(p+1) that c(t) = sign(σ) F(S.indexMap(t,σ)^op)(c(t ∘ σ)). Then for every t : Fin(p+2) → I and permutation σ of Fin(p+2), d_p(c)(t) = sign(σ) F(S.indexMap(t,σ)^op)(d_p(c)(t ∘ σ)).

source.place: Section 20.23, Tag 01FG: verification omitted immediately before Definition 01FH; signed extension preceding Lemma 01FJ

proof.text: expand both differentials as signed face sums. For a permutation σ and a deleted position j, put k = σ⁻¹(j), and let τ be the induced permutation of the remaining positions, so σ ∘ k.succAbove = j.succAbove ∘ τ. Moving j and k to the last position shows (-1)^j sign(τ) = sign(σ) (-1)^k. Apply the assumed transformation law to the jth face, then reindex the sum by k. The two restriction composites agree since opens form a poset. Restriction preserves finite sums and integer scalar multiplication, giving exactly the asserted equality. This proof does not require the tuple to be injective, nor division by two; it also works for p = 0 and for an empty index type.

theorem cechDifferential_permutation (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v}
    (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (c : S.cochains F p)
    (hc : ∀ (t : Fin (p + 1) → I) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1))),
      c t = (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t σ).op (c (t ∘ σ)))
    (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) :
    S.differentialValue F p c t =
      (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t σ).op (S.differentialValue F p c (t ∘ σ))
